body.purpose: One engine on this machine the page mounts to over a socket, nothing polled: the stores attached read only, each renewed as its ref moves, the home a folder of the host’s own, the socket refused to any other origin and refusing attach; the tools unchanged. Read after by one Fable and one Opus, compared, and against the brief.
body.step: The one engine, its smallest step
